notes: S1-FIX3 V5/§5.3/§14.1 (recheck2 M2/n4): the local keyset omits org-1's declaration. The earliest context declaration (T0) claims org-1 as human but its public_key is not 32-byte base64url: public_key is a structural property, so that declaration is not structurally valid, is invalid E_KEY_PUBLIC_KEY, and never governs the class. The later T1 organization declaration (cosigned by the keyset root human-1) is structurally valid, is the governing declaration, and is valid; there is no E_KEY_CLASS_CONFLICT. A declaration with a bad public_key inside a keyset is a usage error (exit 2), which the committed vector format cannot express; it is covered by a unit test and noted in vectors/README.md.
